details: Coinbase has partnered with payments infrastructure provider Moov to enable stablecoin acceptance, settlement, and real-time funding for over 1,000 community banks and credit unions. This integration aims to streamline stablecoin usage within traditional finance. In a related development, India's Securities and Exchange Board (SEBI) launched a pilot program to issue and settle corporate bonds as blockchain tokens, with three companies already raising $107 million through this framework. Additionally, Canada's Office of the Superintendent of Financial Institutions (OSFI) clarified that tokenized bank deposits hold the same legal equivalence as traditional deposits. These advancements signal growing institutional engagement and regulatory clarity for digital assets.
title: Coinbase Expands Stablecoin Adoption, India & Canada Advance Tokenization

details: Bitcoin and the broader cryptocurrency market saw a recovery following the release of the latest US Consumer Price Index (CPI) data for August 2026. The inflation figures matched economists' forecasts, alleviating concerns of a higher-than-expected reading. This outcome sustained market expectations for a Federal Reserve interest rate hike in the upcoming week. Bitcoin specifically rose 1.9% to $78,914.6, though it was still on track for a weekly decline. Other major altcoins, including Ethereum, XRP, Solana, and BNB, also posted gains.
title: Bitcoin Rebounds After In-Line US Inflation Report
